headings.rules: Use Playfair Display for all headings. The word 'Legacy' in the hero should be italicized for an editorial twist. Avoid center alignment; favor strict left-aligned typographic grids.

body.rules: Montserrat provides clean, structured, and legible contrast to the decorative serif headings. Ensure all small labels/overline text uses intense uppercase tracking (e.g., tracking-[0.2em]).

colors.rules: No flat, generic gradients. Use radial gradients or noise overlays for depth. Do not use pure `#000000` — base is `#0B0B0B`. Gold (`#D4AF37`) is strictly for interaction states, key thin borders, and the signature marquee. Vivid purple (`#6B1FAF`) is for subtle hover glows on cards.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly for the sticky navbar and floating elements. Requires `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-[#D4AF37]/20`. No fully transparent headers over hero images.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate a subtle noise/grain overlay globally (`mix-blend-overlay` on a pseudo-element) to kill digital flatness and enhance the luxury feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid `#D4AF37` at 20% opacity for container dividers. High-contrast solid gold lines for active tab states or animated underlines.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal use of standard drop-shadows. Instead, rely on glowing radial drop-shadows `drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(107,31,175,0.4)]` for hover states on key components.

components.navbar: Sticky, glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0B0B]/70`), 1px bottom gold border. Links must be visible on desktop (no hamburger).
components.hero: Kinetic Hero. Left-aligned heavy typography: 'Strength. Vision. Legacy.' (with 'Legacy' in italic serif and gold). Masked reveal animation (line by line). Abstract dark gold texture as background, deeply darkened (`bg-black/60` overlay) so text pops.
components.marquee: Slow, elegant editorial marquee drifting across the screen behind or between sections. Text should be large (`text-8xl`), serif italic, and transparent with a 1px gold outline (`text-stroke`).
components.dba_cards_grid: Bento-style or numbered Manifesto grid. Avoid basic equal squares. Use tall vertical cards (`col-span-1 row-span-2`) mixed with wide horizontal strips. Hover state: subtle scale, image desaturates slightly, vivid purple ambient glow behind.
components.impact_counters: Large, fluid typography for numbers (e.g., Montserrat Light). Use framer-motion `useSpring` and `useTransform` to animate counters from 0 when scrolled into view. Do not use generic icons; use bespoke gold line-art or diamond/crown SVGs.
components.forms: Use Shadcn customized primitives. Inputs: transparent background, 1px bottom border (`#BFBFBF`), focus state turns bottom border gold (`#D4AF37`). No chunky default borders.
components.footer: Massive top padding (`py-32`). Left side: giant 'JPNS ENTERPRISE' text. Right side: Newsletter form (minimalist line input) and social links. Deep purple ambient glow in the background.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use `py-24` to `py-32` between sections. `gap-8` to `gap-16` for grids. This breathing room creates a sense of luxury.
grids_and_layouts.dba_grid: Asymmetrical layout. `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8`. E.g., Card 1: `col-span-7`, Card 2: `col-span-5`.

motion.scroll_reveal: Masked upward reveals for headings (`overflow-hidden` wrapper, text translates Y from 100% to 0% with `ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1]`, duration: 1s).
motion.parallax: Use Framer Motion's `useScroll` and `useTransform` for subtle Y-axis shifting on DBA card images as the user scrolls, creating a 'window' effect.
motion.interactions: Hover on cards translates Y by `-8px`, extends transition duration to `0.4s ease-out`.
motion.marquee_speed: Extremely slow. Use `react-fast-marquee` or framer-motion with a 30s-60s linear loop.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white/gold text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio against the #0B0B0B/#2B0B3D backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Custom focus rings: `focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#D4AF37] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#0B0B0B]`.
accessibility.motion_preference: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for kinetic text and parallax elements.
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive elements, forms, cards, and primary text must have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='hero-heading'`, `data-testid='dba-card-luxury-cars'`).

media.treatment: Real photography treated deliberately: darkened, slightly desaturated, with a subtle noise overlay to match the brand. Use clipping masks or strict geometric crops (no soft rounded corners — sharp 0px or max 2px radii for luxury edge).
media.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Render them with `color='#D4AF37'` and `strokeWidth={1}` for a refined, delicate gold line-art aesthetic.

3d_libraries.recommendation: For the hero, stick to framer-motion 2D parallax and masking. The prompt asks for 'subtle parallax/3D hero moment'. We will implement a deep, multi-layered parallax using Framer Motion `useScroll` instead of heavy WebGL (R3F) to keep the site extremely snappy while achieving the Site-of-the-Day feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `framer-motion`, `lucide-react`, `@studio-freight/react-lenis`, `react-fast-marquee`, and setup Shadcn components using `div/span` wrappers where custom HTML is better for artistic control.
Set the Tailwind config to use Playfair Display and Montserrat. Extend colors with void_black (#0B0B0B), deep_purple (#2B0B3D), vivid_purple (#6B1FAF), and lux_gold (#D4AF37).
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling globally in the App component.
Build the Kinetic Hero: Create a Framer Motion component that masks text line-by-line. Wrap lines in `overflow-hidden` and translate Y from 100% to 0%.
Develop the DBA Division section as an asymmetrical bento grid. Apply subtle `useScroll` parallax to the images inside `overflow-hidden` containers so they move at a different rate than the scroll.
Create animated counters for the Impact section using Framer Motion `useSpring` with `useInView` triggers.
Design minimalist custom forms with single-line bottom borders (border-b-1) that transition to gold on focus.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive, dynamic, and major content elements.
Ensure the .js files are used, no .tsx/TypeScript code.
Do not use generic Shadcn Cards for the main DBA layout; construct raw HTML + Tailwind divs for precise, edge-to-edge luxury styling.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (e.g., sharp 0px radius for this luxury brand) with interaction animations & relevant colors.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
